label: intro
narration: Day one at Acme Inc. Dana opens RobOS for the first time. Security Setup is the first step.

label: app-launcher
narration: The App Launcher is one click away.

label: search
narration: A quick search brings up Security Setup.

label: pinentry
narration: Step one — configure Pinentry, the secure dialog GPG uses for passphrases.

label: gpg-form
narration: Step two — Dana enters her name, email, and a strong passphrase to create her GPG key.

label: keygen
narration: RobOS generates the key pair. Takes just a moment.

label: pass-store
narration: Step three — the password store is initialized and encrypted with Dana's GPG key.

label: ssh
narration: Step four — generate an SSH key. RobOS creates an Ed twenty-five five one nine key pair for GitHub access.

label: done
narration: Step five — all set. GPG encryption, secure password storage, and SSH. Done in under two minutes.
